limitations: FALCON targets have irreversible upstream global quantile normalization across time and muscles; raw EMG absent.
FALCON B draft metadata mutable; asset UUID and SHA256 identify inspected bytes.
LINK establishes sampled count coverage through explicit references, not uninterrupted raw recording.
Contact correspondence does not establish longitudinal neuron identity.
